title: notification-validation-failed
description: Result event returned to the originator's reply queue (ASB subject notification-validation-failed) when a send-email or send-letter command is rejected because its payload cannot be read or fails validation. Gateway-only: legacy notification-notify answered the same case with a synchronous 400 (see ADR-002 D14). The command is not accepted, so no notificationId is issued; the originator correlates through originalEventPayload. Additive-only evolution.

details.description: In the Jakarta Bean Validation form 'field: message': every violation, comma-separated and sorted by field (e.g. 'sendToAddress: must not be blank'); for a payload that could not be read, the JSON parser's message, prefixed with the field when known.

originalEventPayload.description: The command message body exactly as received, as a JSON string.
